capabilities: Track physical cards in lists with finish, condition, language, grading and custom price
Build decks with mainboard, sideboard, Commander slot and statistics like mana curve
Maintain wantlists with a mark-as-acquired action that moves cards into the collection
Search cards with a query syntax (colours, sets, oracle text) and add them from Scryfall in any language
Import and export CSV, plain-text decklists and ZIP archives
extras: Extensive privacy and network-use documentation listing every external service contacted. Prices are described as third-party indications, not offers. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to catalog a physical card collection, build decks, or fetch card data and prices for them.

relations.evidence: Card data, images and symbols come from Scryfall. This plugin is not made by or affiliated with Scryfall.
The price history is built from MTGJSON (MIT License, © Zach Halpern)

requires.name: own private GitHub repository with a fine-grained access token

summary: Collection tracker that manages a physical Magic: The Gathering collection, decks and wantlists, with card data and prices from Scryfall.
